summary: Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, Sertindole received high risk scores for both liver and heart harm [M]. Starting in 1998, the drug was pulled from the market in Germany and six other countries due to heart harm [3]. In addition, several clinical trials studying Sertindole were affected or stopped because of problems recruiting enough patients, poor patient compliance, and high dropout rates [5][6][7].
